answer: Beacon-anchored epoch deduplication. Each identity must submit a unique proof-of-work hash per epoch, seeded by a public beacon, before it can send any agent message. Duplicate or late submissions are rejected at the lagoon gateway, so replicas hold no shared channel. A cipher ties each submission to prior epoch state, preventing precomputation. Attackers pay full compute per fake identity per epoch, uncapped by coordination; honest agents pay one hash.
